steps.name: Seeker of Power (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lena] in the "Guild Inn", then find [Yuran] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters".

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Resting well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well enough. You said you had something to tell me. Do you remember now?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You make it sound like I forgot because of the drink. Well, whatever...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: While you were sorting out the trouble at Xerenis Magic Academy, someone came looking for you.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Short hair and glasses. Quite memorable. Looked like she came from Jiendia or Eastland.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: She looked ordinary, but we could sense she was highly skilled and concealing tremendous strength. Everyone was wary.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: But the strength carried in her gentle voice made everyone trust her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yuran... Ziskad's first disciple. He's the Sword Master and leader of Eastland's Alliance of Light.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: A disciple of someone called the Sword Master would be no ordinary person. Anyway, Einst told me you'd arrived, so I gave her your whereabouts.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (Perhaps Her Majesty knew this would happen, too...)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You don't mind that I told her where you were, do you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not really. Personal information seems to become public property sooner or later in this world.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about. Anyway, she asked you to visit when you returned...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it urgent?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lena. I'll go. Don't drink too much.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: All right. But don't be late when it's time to receive the decree.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're here, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? I heard you went all the way to the Guild Alliance...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: First, I owe you an apology. Truthfully, I didn't want to seek you out.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I intended to handle this myself, but my master instructed otherwise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. What did Ziskad say?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's about Ull. He's the youngest of my master's disciples, and the most talented.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Despite his talent, he never neglects his training. He works diligently every day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's certainly confident, too.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Confidence can become arrogance in an instant. My master and I warn him of that, but he doesn't seem to listen.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He's in considerable danger now. My master and I have both seen 'him' reflected in Ull.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Him? Who?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll tell you. His name is Baral...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm known as the first disciple, but he came before me.

lines.speaker: 유런
lines.text: Like Ull, Baral was a fine disciple, talented and tireless in his training.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: But despite his ability, he couldn't protect everyone in a battle against the Deimos cult.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He felt his strength was lacking and became obsessed with gaining more. The sword he'd taken up to protect others began to change.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: My master told him to abandon that obsession, but he wouldn't listen.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then something happened at the forbidden entrance to the Zisk Territory... The combat guild members tried to stop him on my master's orders, and he...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry to bring up such a story. Please persuade Ull, %s.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: My master asks it as well. He trusts you completely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not skilled enough to match Ull. How can I...?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He may listen to you, %s, since you're working for Lady Iris. You wield strength too, but toward a different purpose...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so, I'll talk to him. But I don't see him here. Where is he?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I heard he went to the Amaloon Desert to train.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find him and try to persuade him quickly. Tell him you and Ziskad are worried.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Yuran bows her head in earnest request.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I'll be back.

steps.name: Seeker of Power (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Mautu] in the "Hall of Rest", then report to [Tia] in the "Amaloon Desert".

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I felt a slight change in the stars' movements. It was you, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Tia. I'd like to talk longer, but I'm busy and need to hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you seen someone like this? About this tall, hair like this... A rather cheeky-looking boy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You describe Ull with a few gestures.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, I saw someone entering the Hall of Rest. I warned him it was dangerous, but he went in anyway.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: His expression and manner seemed a little strange.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I could only wait for him to return. Then you arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the Hall of Rest like now?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You're going inside? A faint trace of the god of the dead's sinister power remains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone asked me to find him. I have to go.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then come close for a moment.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tia takes %s's hands. Soon she speaks words that sound as though they belong to another world.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that your world's language?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes. An ancient language of our world. I don't know it in detail myself...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: My mother used to say those words when praying to keep misfortune away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll return quickly.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Please be careful.

steps.name: Seeker of Power (4)
steps.objective: Find [Ruin] at the "Underground City Construction Site".

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Are you all right, adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. I found traces of Ull, but he'd already left. Did you see him?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes. He came out of the Hall of Rest. I tried to ask him to wait, but he shook me off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did he say anything?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Only, 'Can't stop. Must do more. Not enough...' He looked just like...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tia, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: ...But I'm worried about him.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: He looked desperate for power. Almost obsessed... My younger sibling had that same expression when making a pact with the god of the dead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... I hope nothing happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which way did Ull go?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Toward Tartaros. I hear there's a place full of demons there. Could he have gone to it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Probably. Shynic keeps demons and monsters imprisoned there. The Abyss Chamber...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry, Princess. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Please take care, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll ask Ruin at the Underground City Construction Site if he's seen Ull. Better hurry.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: What brings you to the construction site? Need the Abyss Chamber again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... Someone asked me to find a person.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I don't know whom you're after, but did they enter the Abyss Chamber?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: A little brat? Looks incredibly full of himself?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly describe Ull to Ruin.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Yes, that's him. He did a lap of the construction site and looked thoroughly unsatisfied.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sounds like Ull...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Ull? That's his name? Silver Sword Dragon Ull? Ziskad's youngest disciple?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: First time I've seen a disciple of that famous Sword Master. Haha.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: His expression reminded me of Randine back then. It worries me. Whoever asked you must be worried about him, too.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You know how to use your strength when it matters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still don't know how I should use it.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Too much humility can be poison. Sometimes you've got to puff up your chest and brag.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: He entered the Abyss Chamber recently. Hurry, and you might catch him halfway through.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Ruin. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better find where Ull is training...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you are. Won't even acknowledge a visitor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking about so hard?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Nothing. How much more training I need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to talk.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yuran sent you with her pointless worries again, I suppose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know perfectly well. Are you doing this on purpose?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't want to discuss it. It never leads anywhere. More to the point, you...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Your power feels stranger each time. Perhaps you're...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ull raises his sword before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Why all of a sudden...?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ull lowers his sword and gives a faint laugh.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Sorry. My mistake. This chamber is full of foul energy. I must have sensed it wrong for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you wanted to spar.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Amusing. You think you'd make a suitable opponent for me?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (As Ull smiles faintly, a tremendous force erupts around him, then vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'll accept you as an official sparring partner soon. Train hard until then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'll pass.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I want to try. Consider it a formal request. You defeated that talkative crow here, didn't you? I'm interested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did, but at the time...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Never mind. We'll discuss it later. I'm going back to training. Get lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I tell Yuran?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Tell her not to worry. It's ordinary training. Nothing will happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you insist, I'll head back.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ull keeps swinging his sword after %s disappears. A little later, unfamiliar presences make him stop.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Strange energy. Shall I watch for a moment?)
(A red-haired man and woman seem to be returning from somewhere. Both are scowling, as though things went badly.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: How much longer must we walk? With a magic stone, we'd be there...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Mara, how many times have I told you? We have no choice if we want to avoid Shynic. I erased our tracks all this way, and now you say that?

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Fine, stop it. But do we really need traces of the Demon Realm brought by demons? We've still got plenty of stones. Enough to handle something like Moss...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: (Mara takes out a pouch of magic stones. Ban snatches it and throws it to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Ban, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: You think these stones can do everything, but we've failed over and over. Think differently for once!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: It's all that goddess and her follower. Interfering in every plan... Next time, I'll kill that one for certain.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: You said making a contract with that man would secure our place on the continent. What is this, then...?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: That's over. Forget it. Damn it. That snake Prince Nox won't listen... We've come this far. We can only see it through.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: We have to make one last stand before Moss falls.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: All right, brother. Let's go to Oneiro... But those stones...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Leave them. They're defective. We can't use them properly anyway.
(As Ban and Mara disappear toward the chamber's entrance, Ull slowly emerges from the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So they were behind it... But these stones still seem to have mana.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're back. Where was Ull?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Abyss Chamber in Tartaros. I'd been before, so finding him wasn't difficult.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The Abyss Chamber, of all places...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Malphas came there from the Demon Realm and caused a commotion in Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Many tried to defeat him for Shynic's bounty. None succeeded. Some lost their lives and had their souls taken.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ull also tried, but was injured by someone named Randine and had to rest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He meant to challenge Malphas again, but you had already defeated him and continued your journey.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He doesn't show it, but he must be concerned about you, %s.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Someone who defeated an opponent he couldn't...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying he's obsessed with power because of me? I only did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry if it sounded that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't you treating him too much like a child? He said it's ordinary training and nothing will happen...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Understood. I'll tell my master.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And please don't ask me to go searching for Ull again.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Iris's training going well? I haven't had a chance to see her true self...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Her true self...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. She's concentrating on training. I shouldn't disturb her... I'll return to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then may your journey be uneventful.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (As %s disappears into the distance beyond Lumen, Iris slowly approaches Yuran.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Training finished early today. Bilbradha said he'd had enough, too...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The true self has arrived.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please keep to the schedule. As you said yourself, Lady Iris, it could affect %s. The adventurer only just left.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will. I'm sorry. But...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please don't use that person and Ull to test it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I wasn't using them. I merely wanted to know... If, just if...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If something has gone wrong, Jin and I will cut the adventurer down ourselves.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That will never happen. That person will never become that. Because I do not wish it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Understood. None of us wants the worst...
